stack-versions.text: Spring Boot 4.1.1 parent BOM, Java 21, Maven wrapper; Next.js 15.5.25, React 19.1.0, Tailwind 4, TypeScript 5. H2 runtime + PostgreSQL runtime in backend/pom.xml. Deps: webmvc, data-jpa, validation, actuator.

code-conventions.text: No Lombok: manual getters/setters with guard clauses throwing IllegalArgumentException in constructors and setters. Entities extend BaseEntity (audit fields). Package com.fintech.ledger.PaymentGateway. Repository tests use H2; Payment.record() owns status transitions; Payment.capturedAmountInUsd() computes captures net of refunds via Currency.getUsdRate().

decisions.text: system-design.md decision: monolithic Spring Boot module, /api REST prefix, error body {status,error,message,timestamp} via RestControllerAdvice, idempotent POST /api/payments by idempotencyKey returning 200 on duplicate, 409 on illegal state transition, H2 dev / Postgres prod, static X-API-Key auth (TASK-04). Revisit triggers documented in docs/system-design.md section 7.

boot4-h2console.text: Spring Boot 4 moved the H2 console servlet into org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-h2console (runtime scope). Without it, spring.h2.console.enabled=true silently does nothing and /h2-console 404s. Verified 2026-09-17 against docs.spring.io/spring-boot/reference/data/sql.html.

boot4-package-layout.text:
Boot 4 test annotations live in new packages: org.springframework.boot.data.jpa.test.autoconfigure.DataJpaTest, org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.WebMvcTest. Use spring-boot-starter-webmvc-test / spring-boot-starter-data-jpa-test artifacts. Hibernate 7 auto-detects dialect; never set spring.jpa.database-platform explicitly.
 MockMvc auto-config annotation: org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc.

api-error-contract.text: GlobalExceptionHandler returns {status, error, message, timestamp}: 400 MethodArgumentNotValid, 404 NotFoundException, 409 DuplicateEmailException, 500 fallback (message logged, generic body). TASK-03 reuses it; only new exception types need mapping.

domain-ledger-invariants.text: Payment.record() rejects illegal transitions (IllegalStateException -> 409 via GlobalExceptionHandler). FAILED transactions always recorded and set status FAILED regardless of current state. FEE type has no transition yet (TASK-08). Ledger rows persist ONLY through Payment's CascadeType.ALL: an extra transactionRepository.save() double-inserted rows and made capturedAmountInUsd report 140 instead of 70.

auth-model.text: TASK-04: ApiKeyAuthFilter (plain jakarta Filter via FilterRegistrationBean, /api/payments/* only, order 1). X-API-Key -> MerchantRepository.findByApiKey; unknown/missing -> 401, non-ACTIVE merchant -> 403, else authenticatedMerchantId request attribute consumed by PaymentController @RequestAttribute. Merchant/actuator endpoints stay open (MVP admin trust). Body merchantId != authenticated id -> 403. Filter JSON errors written via tools.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper (Jackson 3 moved from com.fasterxml in Boot 4). Cross-merchant READS intentionally allowed; revisit trigger documented in docs/plans/TASK-04.md.

portal-wiring.text: Admin portal (TASK-05): server components fetch PAYMENT_API_BASE (default localhost:8080) with PAYMENT_API_KEY env for payment pages; merchant pages key-exempt. Next 15 searchParams/params are Promises in async pages. Fonts via next/font: Libre Franklin/Source Sans 3/IBM Plex Mono. Tailwind 4 tokens via @theme inline mapping CSS vars. Register form uses useActionState server action + revalidatePath. Walkthrough verified: register -> key -> payment -> authz -> capture -> detail ledger renders CAPTURED; 404 and error states render; intent.py scan 0 findings; gates PASS after build.

boot4-teststack.text: Boot 4 test stack: TestRestTemplate lives in org.springframework.boot.resttestclient (artifact spring-boot-resttestclient, inside starter-webmvc-test); enable with @AutoConfigureTestRestTemplate on RANDOM_PORT tests, plus test-scope spring-boot-restclient for RestTemplateBuilder. Benchmark harness: ./mvnw -q -Pbenchmark exec:java writes benchmarks/results/baseline-<date>.{md,json}; lifecycle forbids double-authorize so warmup+measured auth calls each need a fresh payment.

pagination.text: TASK-07: list endpoints return PageResponse<T> envelope; PageRequests.of() is the single validated factory (1..100, createdAt DESC, server-fixed sort); MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException mapped to 400; servlet filter auth runs before controller validation so list-endpoint validation tests need a real key; admin portal consumes via Page<T> in lib/api.ts

fee-transactions.text: TASK-08: Payment.record() accepts FEE only in AUTHORIZED/CAPTURED/REFUNDED (409 otherwise), fee <= payment.amount (compareTo, boundary allowed), status never changes, capturedAmountInUsd still excludes fees (sign 0). Multiple fees allowed. All five TransactionType values now have explicit branches in record().

portal-auth.text: TASK-09: portal staff views gated by PORTAL_PASSCODE (server-only env); session = HMAC-signed cookie ledger_session (expiry.hmac, key = HMAC-SHA256(passphrase, 'ledger-portal-session-v1'), 12h, timing-safe, fails closed when unset, rotation kills all sessions); guard lives in app/(staff)/layout.tsx using x-portal-path header set by src/middleware.ts (login excluded from matcher); logout is POST /logout route handler (303 to /login); cookie survives portal restarts (stateless) but NOT backend restarts that rotate PAYMENT_API_KEY; Next 15 server actions cannot set cookies then redirect in try/catch - redirect() throws by design

load-benchmark.text: TASK-10: LoadBenchmark (profile benchmark-load) = closed-loop worker pools at 1/4/16/64/128/256, 40 warmup + 240 measured per (scenario,level); scenarios CREATE, RECORD_AUTHORIZATION (fresh pre-seeded payments - lifecycle forbids double-authz), GET_DETAIL, LIST_PAYMENTS, MIXED (50/25/15/10). Measured on H2+Hikari defaults: writes break 200ms p99 between 16-64 workers (connection-pool queueing: 362/481ms at 64), LIST breaks at 64 (232ms), GET_DETAIL survives to 256 (149ms), MIXED survives to 256 (195ms). First lever if write bursts matter: hikari maximum-pool-size + verify PostgreSQL parity, not app code. Client needs http.maxConnections=300 or JDK keep-alive pool (default 5) fakes a bottleneck.

merchant-lifecycle.text: TASK-11: Merchant owns its lifecycle (activate PENDING->ACTIVE domain-only, suspend ACTIVE->SUSPENDED, reactivate SUSPENDED->ACTIVE, close any-non-terminal->CLOSED terminal); public setStatus removed (package-private for JPA), so tests reach non-ACTIVE states via transitions. Endpoints POST /api/merchants/{id}/suspend|reactivate|close; illegal transition -> IllegalStateException -> 409. ApiKeyAuthFilter already 403s non-ACTIVE keys ('merchant is suspended'), so suspends bite immediately. Registration creates ACTIVE directly, so PENDING is API-unreachable by design. Portal: merchantLifecycleAction server action + MerchantActions.tsx contextual buttons (CLOSED renders no actions). Ops gotchas learned: npm run build while next dev is running clobbers .next and breaks hydration (server actions then submit as native GETs); a running backend started before new endpoints exist answers NoResourceFoundException -> was 500, now mapped to 404.

portal-pagination.text: TASK-12: Pagination.tsx is a server component driven purely by the envelope (page/totalPages/totalElements) + hrefFor callback; URL-driven ?page=N, no client state, works without JS. parsePageParam in lib/params.ts degrades bad input to 0. Out-of-range pages are NOT redirected: render the truthful indicator (Page N of M with N>M) and Previous targets min(page-1, totalPages-1) so recovery is one click; empty-state text only when totalElements==0 (empty states must not lie - design rule). Payments hrefs preserve the status filter. Ops: stop next dev before npm run build (shared .next)
